item.description: Paul Scarr says he will cross the floor of the Senate to vote against Labor's gambling advertising bill, defying his party's official position. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Gould

item.title: More women being diagnosed with POTS but rural patients face extra toll
item.description: Being diagnosed with postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome in regional Australia means treatment is far away and local understanding of the condition is minimal. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sam Bradbrook and Becc Bird

item.title: Erin Patterson, Woman Convicted in Australia’s Mushroom Murder Case, Appeals
item.description: An Australian woman, Erin Patterson, was found guilty of murdering three of her husband’s relatives and trying to kill a fourth by serving them deadly mushrooms. Fuente: The New York Times - World.
item.dc:creator: Laura Chung

item.title: Fears mass bird deaths in south-west Victoria linked to bird flu
item.description: People in the south-west Victorian town of Portland fear a deadly bird flu is to blame for hundreds of bird deaths this week, as carcasses begin to pile up. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Sanders, Jean Bell, Jeremy Lee, and Violette Storm

item.title: Aboriginal community-controlled healthcare improving life expectancy in the NT
item.description: While the life expectancy of Indigenous people in remote communities has improved, Aboriginal health groups are telling the federal and Northern Territory governments a lot more work is still needed to close the gap. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jane Bardon

item.title: Police release CCTV footage of Melbourne arson linked to bikies
item.description: The resident of a house targeted by arsonists last year was the victim of a violent $20 million extortion attempt by three members of the Bandidos weeks before the attack. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Darts offers Moranbah miners a break from camp life
item.description: The previous darts club, about 200 kilometres north-east of Mackay, closed a few years ago, but the dedication and perseverance of a few members has brought it back to life. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Vanessa Jarrett

item.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
item.description: Tributes paid to ‘great friend and collaborator’ who played with band for 56 years and died in hospice care in Texas The ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard has died at the age of 77. A spokesperson for the band confirmed to the Guardian that Beard died on 17 August in hospice care at his ranch in Richmond, Texas. His family were by his side. Continue reading... Publicado también por: ABC News Australia, Variety. Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Owen Myers

item.title: Working from home should be a right, not a reward
item.description: The Australian state of Victoria was due to enforce a legal right to work from home starting in September 2026. But just weeks away from its implementation, the new premier, Ben Carroll, announced a year's delay in response to fierce business opposition. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Former AFL player Ricky Henderson sues Fox Sports, AFL over genitals exposure
item.description: Former professional footballer Ricky Henderson is suing the AFL and Fox Sports for more than $1.2 million in damages over an incident in which "compromising footage" of him was aired on live television in 2013. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Mason and Jordanna Schriever

item.title: Fifty years on, Judith has figured out why going to school was hard
item.description: Despite being a keen student in the 1960s and 70s, Judith felt unable to attend school regularly. Fifty years on, she is finally figuring out why going to school was so hard. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alison Costelloe

item.title: $4.3m pilot to help victim-survivors navigate NSW justice system
item.description: The two-year pilot program will make it easier for victim-survivors to access support throughout the criminal justice process in New South Wales. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Baker

item.title: Hospital faces 'day of reckoning' as CEO disappears and ED overwhelmed
item.description: Mildura hospital, one of the biggest employers in the region, is set to undergo an executive shake-up a month on from its CEO's mysterious departure. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Miles and Wade Stephens

item.title: The answer to preventing falls may be as simple as exercise
item.description: At almost 80 years old, grandmother Sandra Franklin still wants to pick up her grandkids. She knows exercise is key to keeping her moving. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lottie Twyford

item.title: Queensland social housing waitlist drops to 44,000 with 'work to do'
item.description: The latest figures for July showed 44,294 people on the waitlist, a drop from the 48,539 recorded in October 2024 when the LNP came to office. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Thai police reveal cause of death of teen allegedly murdered by Australian man

item.title: Lone doctor's plea for help in quake-struck Indonesia as 40,000 displaced

item.dc:creator: Tim Swanston and Erwin Renaldi

item.title: New mum returns to international 'murderball' with blunt new perspective
item.description: Ella Sabljak returns to international competition less than a year after giving birth to her first child, with the Australian Steelers in the hunt for Wheelchair Rugby World Championship glory in Brazil. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Erin Patterson's bid to overturn her murder convictions begins
item.description: Lawyers for triple-murderer Erin Patterson will appeal to have her conviction overturned in the Supreme Court, while prosecutors will attempt to have the possibility of parole removed. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Tasmania inquiry to weigh costs, benefits of new AI data centres
item.description: With communities around the world grappling with the spread of AI data centres, the Tasmanian Greens have set up an inquiry to examine "what, if any, economic benefit" they will bring to the state. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Women who feared losing vital cancer treatment offered new hope

item.title: AFL policy is to wait while police investigate. The Swans may not
item.description: Fresh statements from the AFL and Sydney Swans responding to an alleged hotel incident signalling a tough approach and imminent sanctions have been welcomed by advocates, but the delay raises questions about the league's policies. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: What we do and don't know about guns in Australia
item.description: Gun control researchers say we have "no idea" how many black market and 3D-printed weapons are out there. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: A plan to create a red flag system that tags customers showing signs of problem gambling is labelled weak by advocates. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: On the Great Barrier Reef, management by Traditional Owners is growing
item.description: PERTH, Australia — “There’s this beautiful underwater garden out there,” says Mercy Singleton, referring to the vast network of colorful corals that make up the Great Barrier Reef off eastern Australia’s Queensland coast. “We’d like to see it safe and recovering.” Singleton is Yirrganydji and director of Research and Engagement Services at Dawul Wuru Aboriginal Corporation. item.title: Quiz: We're going on a road trip and you're invited
item.description: What is the name of the ancient trade route that linked the East and West? Which country has the tradition of eating KFC for Christmas dinner? Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: The delicate (and smoky) art of painting with fire
item.description: Pyrography — or the craft of making art with fire — has been around for thousands of years. But a new generation of young artists is making the practice their own. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australian beekeepers can't tackle Varroa mite alone. Here's how we can help
item.description: For decades, Australia was the last inhabited continent free of the bee-killing Varroa mite (Varroa destructor). Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Pivotal Meta trial over social media addiction in children gets underway
item.description: Four US states are taking Meta to court, accusing the social media giant of deliberately making Facebook and Instagram addictive for children. They're seeking damages and changes to the company's apps. Publicado también por: Deutsche Welle - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fifteen years of data link plastic pollution to seabird population losses
item.description: Every year, about 50 million metric tons of plastic is dumped into the environment. This waste entangles, chokes and poisons wildlife worldwide, including sable shearwaters living on the remote Australian island of Lord Howe. After hatching on the island, these birds head out to sea for several years before returning to breed as adults. Fuente: Phys.org.
